name: sandsurf-workspace
description: Persistent hardware-isolated Linux environments for autonomous agents

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:ts
scripts.check: npm run check:protocol && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --pretty false && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:ts && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:sandsurf: npm run build:ts && cargo test --locked -p sandsurf-protocol -p sandsurf-state -p sandsurf-native -p sandsurf-machine -p sandsurf-host -- --test-threads=1 && node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/sandsurf/test/sandsurf-contracts.test.mjs
